premises.text: Smart clothing can enhance visibility and safety for cyclists and pedestrians at night
premises.evidence_span: It's designed to save lives by visibility at nighttime

premises.text: Current safety technology is limited in functionality and visibility
premises.evidence_span: the current state of the technology for safety is high-visibility clothing or retro-reflectives or even red tail lights. But these are incredibly limited in their functionality and often invisible from outside angles

premises.text: Wearable smart lighting can communicate location and intentions to drivers
premises.evidence_span: the software is tracking me. So you now know where I'm headed. It knows that I'm going to be making a left onto the Brooklyn Bridge, so it automatically engages a left turn signal when I get to that turn

premises.text: Advanced hardware and software can optimize lighting for visibility and user experience
premises.evidence_span: we've combined advanced hardware with luminous software and an endless opportunity for animation and colors so that we can take virtually any harvestable data and turn that into visual lighting cues, messages, and notifications

premises.text: There is a significant market for smart clothing beyond cycling, including industrial and enterprise safety
premises.evidence_span: countless use cases beyond just cyclists, ranging from consumer all the way to industrial and enterprise safety

premises.text: Partnerships with established brands can enhance market reach and credibility
premises.evidence_span: we have committed POs already from some of these companies

value.text: Luminous provides enhanced safety and visibility for users through smart clothing
value.evidence_span: These keep you seen and could potentially save your life

notes: Sales figures and specific partnerships are included as evidence of traction.
